title: Events
intro: Dates from your program and from the startup ecosystem.
submittedNote: Thank you! Your suggestion will be checked and shown to everyone once approved.
empty: Nothing coming up here right now. The ecosystem grows with every source we are allowed to use and every approved suggestion.
emptySaved: You have not saved anything yet. Tap the bookmark on an event.
legalNote: Only facts are shown here – title, time, place, organizer and the link to the official page – and only from sources we are allowed to use, or added by organizations and checked by us. Everything else is with the organizer.

submit.title: Suggest an event
submit.intro: Know a public event from the startup ecosystem? Enter the facts and link the official page. Once we have checked it, everyone can see it.
submit.urlHint: Must start with https://. Anyone who wants to know more reads on there.
submit.confirm: The event is publicly announced. I only enter facts (title, time, place, organizer, link) – no description, no images.

errors.confirm: Please confirm that the event is public and that you only enter facts.
errors.tooMany: You already have 20 suggestions waiting for review.
errors.notAllowed: Only members of an active organization can suggest events.
errors.url: The link must start with https://.
errors.invalid: Please check the date and details – the event must not be in the past.

admin.title: Review events
admin.intro: Approve added events and maintain sources. Only what we are allowed to use appears.
admin.pendingHint: Open the link and check: is the event publicly announced, and are title and time right?
admin.checkHint: Approve only if the official page announces the event publicly.
admin.sourcesHint: A source delivers a calendar file (iCal) every day. Add one only with a licence or written permission – record where the permission is. Switching it off removes its events right away.
admin.sourceSaved: Source saved. It stays off until you switch it on.
admin.sourceError: The source could not be saved. Please check the details.
admin.addSourceWarning: Only add a source if use is allowed: an open licence (e.g. CC0, CC BY, dl-de) or written permission from the provider. Meetup, Eventbrite, Luma and magazines do not allow this.

fields.name: Name
fields.permissionPlaceholder: e.g. licence page https://… or “Email from name to Maria on 12 Nov 2026”
